comparison.summary: Dallas County, TX (FIPS 48113) is the recommended launch county. Dallas clears the auction math with a green unit-economics verdict—its worst-case CPL stays comfortably below the lead bid with healthy CPC headroom—backed by high hail and wind exposure plus substantial long-tenure equity. By contrast, Cook County, IL (FIPS 17031) fails the auction math with a red verdict where expected CPL does not close below the target bid. Pinellas County (12103) ranks second with strong tropical storm and free-and-clear equity signals, though its auction margin is tighter.
